board.dram_basis: The stock bus-drain selector (0x15b0a5c in firmware 1.12) ends the first memory region at 0xa8000000 and names two further bus ports at 0x100000000 and 0x180000000, so installed capacity is larger and unmeasured.

bus_drain.basis: The stock firmware drains the bus with a discarded read of the end of its first memory region: selector 0x15b0a5c (firmware 1.12) reads 0xa8000000 for addresses from 0xa8000000 to 0xffffffff, where X100VI reads 0x68000000 and X-H2S 0x80000000.
The stock firmware drains the second bus port with a discarded read at 0x100000000; selector 0x15b0a5c (firmware 1.12) uses it for addresses from 0x100000000 to 0x17fffffff.
The stock firmware drains the third bus port with a discarded read at 0x180000000; selector 0x15b0a5c (firmware 1.12) uses it for addresses from 0x180000000 to 0x1ffffffff.

storage_slots.basis: GFX100RF specifications: one SD card slot (UHS-II).
